use_case: Tenant screening recommendations: the property management platform integrated screening service scores each rental application and returns accept, accept with conditions (higher deposit), or decline
business_owner: Residential Brokerage president of property management
vendor_or_model: Tenant screening provider integrated in SYS-B4 (vendor scoring model on consumer report, eviction, criminal record, and income data)
data_categories: Applicant identity data; Social Security numbers; consumer reports (credit, eviction, criminal records); income
human_in_the_loop: Today the recommendation is used as the decision (override rate 1.9%). Required from 2026-11-30: a leasing coordinator reviews every decline or conditional approval against written criteria, with individualized review of criminal and eviction records, before any notice
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604(a)-(b) and (f); 24 CFR 100.500 (in force; HUD proposals pending); state fair housing laws (Fla. Stat. 760.23 worked example); FCRA 15 U.S.C. 1681b and 1681m(a); FCRA disposal rule 16 CFR 682.3; N53-R02 FTC Act Section 5 (45(a))
status: In production (about 68,000 applications a year in 5 states); approved with conditions 2026-08-27 (board risk committee informed 2026-09-17)

use_case: Buyer lead scoring: the CRM scores inbound buyer inquiries (A, B, C) and sets the order in which agents and inside sales respond
vendor_or_model: CRM vendor lead scoring feature (vendor model configured by the brokerage)
data_categories: Inquiry contact data; ZIP code; inquiry language; price range; pre-approval status; web activity
human_in_the_loop: Agents see the score and choose whom to call; every lead must get a same-day response by policy
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604(b) and (d); N53-R02 FTC Act Section 5 (45(a))
status: In production; ZIP code and language inputs to be removed by 2026-12-31

use_case: Generative AI drafts of listing descriptions and marketing copy
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI assistant (AI-009) and a listing-description feature in the CRM
data_categories: Property features and marketing copy; risk of client data being pasted
human_in_the_loop: Agent or marketing staff edits every draft and runs the fair housing check before publication
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604(c) (discriminatory advertising); N53-R02 (45(a)); POL-05 4.8 and 4.9
status: In production; fair housing check required (POL-05 4.9)

use_case: Mortgage pre-qualification model: estimates the loan amount and program a consumer is likely to qualify for, before a full application
vendor_or_model: In-house model in SYS-M1 (gradient-boosted model trained on Home Loans application history since 2019) using a soft credit inquiry and AVM values
data_categories: Stated income and assets; soft-pull credit data; property and ZIP-level value trends; AVM estimate
human_in_the_loop: Loan officers review every pre-qualification before an application decision; consumers can apply regardless of the pre-qualification result
applicable_laws: ECOA 15 U.S.C. 1691 and Reg B 12 CFR 1002.9 (adverse action where a request is an application; counsel review); Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3605; FCRA 15 U.S.C. 1681b; N53-R02 FTC Act Section 5 (45(a))
status: In production (about 210,000 requests a year); continue with conditions

use_case: Automated valuation model (AVM) estimates used in credit decisions: maximum loan amounts in pre-qualification and a collateral check in underwriting that can trigger a second valuation review or change loan terms
vendor_or_model: AVM vendor (third-party model) integrated in SYS-M1
data_categories: Property characteristics; sales history; AVM estimate and confidence score
human_in_the_loop: Underwriters decide; any AVM value more than 10% below the contract price triggers appraisal review rather than an automatic term change
applicable_laws: Reg Z 12 CFR 1026.42(i)(3) (high confidence; data manipulation; conflicts of interest; random sample testing; nondiscrimination), effective 2025-10-01; Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3605; ECOA 15 U.S.C. 1691; N53-R02 (45(a))
status: In production; quality control testing not started (POAM-019); continue with conditions

use_case: Identity verification for closings: document and selfie match before a buyer or seller first sees wire instructions in SYS-B2
vendor_or_model: Identity verification service (vendor face-match and document authentication models)
data_categories: Government ID images; selfie images; face-match scores
consequential_decision_category: None directly (a failed check goes to a Title closer for manual verification)
human_in_the_loop: Every failed check is reviewed the same day by a Title closer who verifies by phone at a number from the title file
applicable_laws: N53-R01 Safeguards Rule (314.3(b)); N53-R02 FTC Act Section 5 (45(a)); Florida biometric classification of face templates unsettled (Fla. Stat. 501.702 definition excludes photographs and data generated from video); treated as biometric data by policy

use_case: Wire anomaly scoring: SYS-G5 scores outgoing wires and payee changes and holds unusual ones for review
vendor_or_model: Bank connectivity vendor fraud scoring module configured by Treasury
data_categories: Payee, amount, account history, device and session data
affects_individuals: Yes (payments to consumers and trade partners)
consequential_decision_category: None (fraud control; a human releases or rejects every held wire)
human_in_the_loop: Treasury analysts review every held wire before release or rejection
status: In production; holds about 1.1% of wires

use_case: Construction schedule optimization: proposes trade sequencing and delivery dates for homes under construction
vendor_or_model: ERP vendor optimization module in SYS-H1
data_categories: Construction schedules, trade capacity, weather, material lead times (no personal data)
human_in_the_loop: Superintendents approve every schedule; safety plans are unchanged
applicable_laws: None specific (internal use); OSHA jobsite duties unchanged

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for drafting, summarizing, and search
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI assistant (SaaS) with no-training and data retention terms
data_categories: Workforce prompts and files; may include customer information
consequential_decision_category: None (prohibited for credit, housing, screening, or valuation decisions)
human_in_the_loop: Users review every output; prohibited uses listed in the Group AI Standard
status: Pilot with 3,000 employees; contractor agents excluded
